title: Safeguarding America's First Responders Act of 2020
official_summary:
Safeguarding America's First Responders Act of 2020

This bill extends death and disability benefits under the Public Safety Officers' Benefits Program (PSOB) to public safety officers (e.g., law enforcement officers) and survivors of public safety officers who die or become injured as a result of COVID-19 (i.e., coronavirus disease 2019). The PSOB program provides death, disability, and education benefits to public safety officers and survivors of public safety officers who are killed or injured in the line of duty.

For purposes of death benefits, this bill creates a general presumption that a public safety officer who dies from COVID-19 or related complications sustained a personal injury in the line of duty.

For purposes of disability benefits, the bill creates a general presumption that COVID-19 or related complications suffered by a public safety officer constitutes a personal injury sustained in the line of duty.

summary.headline: This law extends federal death and disability benefits to public safety officers and their survivors when COVID-19 causes death or injury.
summary.what_it_does: The Public Safety Officers' Benefits Program normally pays benefits to officers and survivors when an officer is killed or hurt in the line of duty. This law adds a general presumption that an officer who dies from COVID-19 or related complications was injured in the line of duty. It also presumes that COVID-19 or related complications suffered by an officer count as a line-of-duty injury for disability benefits.

who_it_affects.group: Public safety officers, such as law enforcement officers
who_it_affects.how: Officers who become disabled by COVID-19 or related complications can be treated as having a line-of-duty injury for disability benefits.

who_it_affects.group: Survivors of public safety officers who die from COVID-19
who_it_affects.how: Eligible survivors, such as family members, can receive death benefits because the officer's COVID-19 death is presumed to be a line-of-duty death.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 14, 2020. The official summary does not state a separate effective date.
